result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.deselect_nodes()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Remove nodes from selection. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L6080-L6154){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.deselect_nodes(node_ids) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Unmarks specified nodes, removing them from the current selection set. Has no effect on nodes that aren't currently selected. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node_ids]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int | str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of node IDs (int) or labels (str) to deselect. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Refine a selection by removing specific nodes using node IDs: ::: {#ef430601 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_path_graph(5) ) # Select all nodes first all_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids(limit=None)) graph.select_nodes_by_id(all_ids) # Deselect first and last nodes node_list = list(graph.get_node_ids(limit=None)) first_id = node_list[0] last_id = node_list[4] graph.deselect_nodes([first_id, last_id]) # Only middle nodes remain selected selected = graph.get_selected_node_ids() # Returns 3 len(selected) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: Can also use labels directly: ::: {#03ac7bfc .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="0") .add_node(label="1") .add_node(label="2") .add_node(label="3") .add_node(label="4") .add_edge(source="0", target="1") .add_edge(source="1", target="2") .add_edge(source="2", target="3") .add_edge(source="3", target="4") ) # Select all nodes first all_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids(limit=None)) graph.select_nodes_by_id(all_ids) # Deselect first and last nodes using labels graph.deselect_nodes(["0", "4"]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 5 Number of edges : 4 Directed : False Density : 0.40 Average degree (min, max) : 1.60 (1, 2) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
